entries.summary: US market is in a Correction (S&P 500 7,623.68, under its 50-day average, breadth 49.6%): hold cash at the top of the band and only place limit orders at support; the Top 3 conditional setups are Devon Energy, RingCentral and W. R. Berkley.
highlights: Rotation out of AI hardware (SOXX -14.52% in two weeks) into oil, defensives and software; Brent settled at 116.72 and Energy hit a record

entries.title: US Portfolio Audit and Capital Reallocation: session of 23 October 2026
entries.summary: Correction regime and a book that behaves like $220,415 of market exposure on an $82,377 net worth: sell three Stage 4 leveraged funds and six LEAPS lines, keep the other 18 equity positions under written stops, buy nothing because the shortlist is empty, and hold 15.3% cash.
highlights: Effective market exposure 267.6% (beta 2.68); a 1% S&P 500 drop is a static proxy loss of about $2,204
Eight lockstep holdings (BE, SKHY, KORU, ASX, SPXL, TQQQ, UDOW, FAS) are 22.4% of net worth and act as one bet
Options book 16.00% of net worth against a 10% hard maximum: six LEAPS lines sold, bucket to 9.75%
Only MSTR is in Stage 2, so the Let-Winners-Run rule protects it; no position is near the 15% cap
GOOG reports 28 October after the close with its stop 2.7% below the close; stop heat is 6.14% of net worth after the plan
